finding.condition: bucket is not None and event.ts_recv_ns >= bucket + MINUTE
finding.defect: Receive-clock crossing is not proof that the prior exchange-minute trade bucket is complete. This emits an incomplete bar and wrongly rejects subsequent strictly ordered exchange trades from the same old minute as LATE.

bounded_v2_acceptance: Finalize a live bucket only when a received trade has a strictly later exchange-minute bucket; preserve actual receive time as availability.
A nontrade quote whose receive clock crossed a minute cannot finalize the prior exchange-trade bucket.
A trade that returns to an already finalized exchange minute must still cause DATA_INVALID; no hindsight repair or late-event deletion.
Explicit terminal watermark handling remains separately bounded; no empty-bar forward filling.
Preserve v1 plan/results/source archive, strategy/cost/risk parameters and outcomes. Freeze distinct v2 inputs/code before any v2 economic run.
scope: Synthetic mechanics reproduction only. No market records read by this reviewer in this step, no source modifications, no network and no economic rerun. Raw June11 causality is a separate author's evidence task.
